title: AC1024 associative constrained-circle node

independentLayoutSource.layout: ACCONSTRAINEDCIRCLE reads a geometry handle, geometry node ID (BL), center/normal/direction (3BD each), radius/start/end parameters (BD each), and the reserved BD only when circle_reserved is true. The AC1024 inline route passes false.
